preconditions.description: The input must be a string.
The string must contain only lowercase letters.
The string must not be empty.

postconditions.description: The output must be a list with exactly two strings.

postconditions.expression: all(c.isupper() if i % 2 == 0 else c.islower() for i, c in enumerate(stdout[0]))
postconditions.description: The first string must have uppercase letters at even indexes and lowercase letters at odd indexes.

postconditions.expression: all(c.isupper() if i % 2 == 1 else c.islower() for i, c in enumerate(stdout[1]))
postconditions.description: The second string must have uppercase letters at odd indexes and lowercase letters at even indexes.
